identity.name: App Development
identity.description: Posibolt mobile apps maintenance and new app development for POS X platform.

goals: Maintain existing Posibolt mobile apps with timely bug fixes and OS compatibility updates
Develop new mobile app capabilities aligned with POS X platform requirements
Ensure app store compliance and publishing hygiene

milestones.name: Existing apps updated for latest OS compatibility
POS X mobile app requirements defined (aligned with BPX)

risks.description: OS updates break existing apps (annual iOS/Android releases)
risks.mitigation: Pre-release beta testing on new OS versions; budget time around annual release cycles

risks.description: POS X mobile requirements unclear until core platform stabilises
risks.mitigation: Align mobile planning with BPX; don't start POS X mobile dev until core APIs stable

dependencies.description: Existing apps connect to V8 APIs
POS X mobile app depends on POS X core APIs being stable
App Store and Play Store review, OS compatibility requirements

notes: Covers maintenance of existing Posibolt mobile apps and future POS X mobile development. POS X mobile should not start until core POS X APIs are stable — premature mobile work will result in rework.
